# Locked gcovr 8.6 fixtures

All fixtures target gcovr 8.6 JSON format `0.14`, the version pinned by the
coverage bundle (`gcovr==8.6`). `provenance.json` pins the source manifest
SHA-256, Python and gcovr versions, and the SHA-256 of every committed fixture
(including intentional invalid-input fixtures).

`fixture-source.c` and `generate-linux-fixtures.sh` provide the reproducible
Linux command. The script uses only the prepared exact Linux bundle's
`python/bin/python3 -I -S app/gcovr-runner.pyz`, a deterministic GCC coverage
source, and a closed descriptor; it prints both raw-output hashes and writes
the raw output as `generated-linux-gcovr-8.6.raw.json` for CI review.
`schema-variants.json` is a hand-composed canonical variant covering the
documented 8.6 field family (destination block IDs, conditions, decisions,
calls, trace sources, exclusions, and an unknown function). It is not claimed
to be raw tool output; Linux CI compares it with the raw output generated by
the script before accepting fixture changes.

This Windows host cannot execute the Linux bundle. It therefore does not claim
to have generated a raw Linux output; the exact CI/Linux command and the
expected locked-bundle identity are recorded in `provenance.json`. Committed
fixtures deliberately contain no host paths or environment data.
